title: $1,000 in Nvidia in 2016 is now worth this
caption:
In January 2016, Nvidia mostly made graphics cards for gamers.
$1,000 in its shares then would be worth about {growth:NVDA:2016-01-04} today (share price only, no dividends).
comment: What will be the next Nvidia? 👇
sources: NVIDIA share price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time

scenes.say: In January twenty sixteen, Nvidia mostly made graphics cards for gamers.
Say you put one thousand dollars into its shares.
